verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only adjacent dunning features. Stripe can automatically retry failed payments and send reminders (docs-13), and it can email customers a link to a Stripe-hosted payment page (docs-25, docs-26), which at most implies a customer can pay with a different method. Nothing describes automatic card updating, backup payment methods, or a dedicated update-payment page. Missing for 10: network account updater for expiring or replaced cards, backup/fallback payment method support, a hosted page specifically for updating payment details, and any independent corroboration.
